title: Joey Barton found guilty of sending offensive posts on social media
summary: Liverpool Crown Court finds former footballer guilty of sending communications with intent to cause distress Ex-footballer Joey Barton has been found guilty by a jury at Liverpool Crown Court of six counts of sending a grossly offensive electronic communication with intent to cause distress or anxiety.
